about.intro: Seamoon Industries manufactures and exports dental and surgical instruments from Sialkot, Pakistan, and offers OEM and private-label services.
about.companyHeading: Dental and surgical instruments from Sialkot
about.companyDescription: Seamoon Industries is based at Small Industrial Estate, Fateh Garh Agency, Cheema Street, Sialkot, Pakistan. The company website describes its work as manufacturing and exporting dental and surgical instruments for international buyers.
about.oemDescription: The company offers OEM and private-label support based on buyer drawings, samples, or concept briefs. Services described on the website include branding and engraving, custom packaging, and instrument set assembly.
about.processDescription: The manufacturing process described on the company website includes raw-material sourcing, forging, machining, heat treatment, surface finishing, quality inspection, packaging, and export documentation. Specific process capability and requirements should be confirmed for each product and order.
